adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` is called without a try/catch, so Zod validation errors will throw and bubble to Next.js as an unhandled exception (500). Likewise, `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, ...)` and the subsequent `JSON.parse(...)` are unguarded; malformed ciphertext/incorrect key/non-JSON plaintext will also throw and result in a 500 rather than a controlled 4xx `{ message }` response. This is verifiable from the diff because no error handling middleware or local try/catch is present around these operations.
